key_idea: n and m are only 1e4, so each query can be answered in O(length) with Boyer-Moore majority vote plus a verification count.
sketch: Parse each pH as an exact integer (whole*1e6 + six decimals) to avoid float comparison. For each query run the majority-vote scan over [l,r] to get a candidate, then count its occurrences and compare with floor(len/2)+1. Total O(n*m) = 1e8 trivial operations. Pitfall: comparing doubles, or forgetting the verification pass.
